native_gates.requirement: Exact Steam game build, mod-loader version/architecture, dependency list, ordinary-tribe registry and custom-ID registration.
native_gates.amendment_requirement: Audit all playable tribes, own rosters and actual native head/segment links/promotion/growth as applicable; A01 does not exclude special tribes.

native_gates.requirement: Action flags and native Dash/Persist/follow-ups, recruitment exhaustion, conversion/transport constructors and stable logical IDs.
Native range/adjacency metric and detection; use one consistent distance implementation for range-1 exchange and range-2 network/abilities.
Per-player fog storage, source-scoped reveal hooks, unit concealment, combat/retaliation callbacks and no-self-reveal guards.
Real naval upgrade costs/research/timing, normal boarding exhaustion, HP/cargo transition, disembarkation, and action-preserving conversion path.
Native home-city/support reassignment, city ownership transfer, harvest/pop queues and missing-pointer recovery.
City siege and income hook order, native deferred level-up choice queue, and player turn callbacks.
Mind Bender/real support, ownership predicates, Rogue ZOC/roads/defense/refunds/score and true elimination hooks.
Cloak hide/detect/eye/Infiltrate requirements, transferred invisibility, genuine reveal sequencing and spawned-Dagger owner.
Current apparent Heal/Recover/Swarm numbers/expiry, status rendering and independent actual/apparent HP conversion.
All allowed foreign/passive/growth forms; terrain-versus-unit output split, fruitless-algae helper, aquatic legality, segments and generation.
native_gates.amendment_requirement: Audit all playable tribes, own rosters and actual native head/segment links/promotion/growth as applicable; A01 does not exclude special tribes.

native_gates.requirement: Battle preview/sweat, all unit info/readiness fields, public scores/cost breakdowns, camera/audio/replay/selection disclosure.
Save schema, migration/version rejection, deterministic commands/replay and crash-safe pending transactions.
AI observation/action APIs and fail-safe scoring of custom abilities; avoid true-type omniscience.
Hot-seat/private multiplayer serialization and viewpoint filtering, same-mod compatibility, spectator/endgame policy and debug privacy.
Art/font/icon/sound reuse permissions and final assets, resolution/scaling/input accessibility. No bundled font files are required.

supplemental_presentation.requirement: Selecting your own Mimic shows Actual mode first, with actual and apparent forms both visible in the panel.
Selecting the same Mimic again toggles to Appearance mode without changing the map sprite.
Selecting a different unit resets that new selection to Actual mode.
An opponent cannot tell from on-map readiness shading whether a shuffled unit has spent its action.
Regroup and Disguise look the same to the opponent aside from the resulting visible board state.
Swap and Stay produce the same public animation family.
A visible disguised Spy that uses Subvert reveals itself; a disguised passive relay Spy does not.
A Mimic performing Smuggle still looks like its apparent form to the opponent before, during, and after the action.
A real unit disguised as a Cloak shows normal eye-warning behavior when appropriate.
If only one participant in a shuffle is visible, the effect does not reveal the invisible partner’s tile.
A genuine Juggernaut disguised as a Raft causes real splash damage but does not play Juggernaut-identifying source animation.
A Mimic Boat apparently upgraded to Bomber shows Bomber-like visuals but cannot deal actual damage.
An actual Raft with an independent apparent Raft can still access Appearance-mode feigned naval upgrades.
Propaganda overlay appears only while an enemy unit/city is selected and only across tiles you can see.
Blackout uses ordinary fog visuals for all opponents and gives no special persistent marker to the caster.
Replays do not leak hidden actual identities through animation choices, path traces, or panel state.
